edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == initializer before binding the staking contract.
setIndex is protected by the onlyManager modifier which compares _owner to msg.sender.
rebase is protected by onlyStakingContract, which checks msg.sender against stakingContract.
onlyManager modifier evaluates msg.sender against _owner.
onlyStakingContract modifier evaluates msg.sender against stakingContract.
pullManagement requires msg.sender == _newOwner to claim ownership.
permit compares block.timestamp against the caller-supplied deadline.
rebase emits block.timestamp in LogSupply, introducing timestamp dependence.
_storeRebase emits block.timestamp in LogSupply, introducing timestamp dependence.
initialize writes the stakingContract state variable.
initialize resets the initializer state variable to zero.
initialize seeds _gonBalances for the staking contract with TOTAL_GONS.
setIndex writes INDEX via gonsForBalance and is only partially guarded.
setIndex performs a guarded write to INDEX protected by onlyManager and INDEX == 0.
rebase adds the computed rebase amount to _totalSupply.
rebase recomputes _gonsPerFragment as TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply).
rebase executes mul/div/add arithmetic on profit and supply with MAX_SUPPLY clamping.
rebase calls _storeRebase to persist rebase metadata.
_storeRebase pushes a new Rebase struct into the rebases array.
_storeRebase calls circulatingSupply() to record post-rebase supply.
_storeRebase calls index() to record the current index.
_storeRebase divides profit_ by previousCirculating_ to compute rebase percent.
transfer mutates _gonBalances for sender and recipient using mul/sub/add.
transferFrom mutates _gonBalances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements _allowedValue[from][msg.sender] before transferring.
approve writes _allowedValue[msg.sender][spender].
_approve writes _allowedValue[owner][spender].
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to _allowedValue.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from _allowedValue.
permit reads and increments the owner's _nonces to protect against replay.
permit calls _approve after validating the recovered signer.
balanceOf reads _gonBalances[who].
balanceOf divides gon balance by _gonsPerFragment.
gonsForBalance multiplies amount by _gonsPerFragment.
balanceForGons divides gons by _gonsPerFragment.
circulatingSupply subtracts staking balance from _totalSupply.
circulatingSupply calls balanceOf(stakingContract).
index() reads the INDEX state variable.
index() calls balanceForGons(INDEX).
Low-level value call can reenter token transfer logic before state settles.
Low-level value call can reenter transferFrom and manipulate allowances/balances.
delegatecall forwards execution into external code that may act as the caller.
initialize uses the stakingContract_ parameter to set stakingContract.
setIndex passes _INDEX into gonsForBalance multiplication.
rebase uses profit_ in mul/div computations that inflate _totalSupply.
rebase forwards epoch_ to events and _storeRebase.
transfer credits gons to the to parameter.
transfer multiplies value by _gonsPerFragment to compute gon amount.
transferFrom debits gons from the from parameter.
approve stores the spender parameter in _allowedValue.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue via SafeMath.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue via SafeMath.
allowance returns _allowedValue[owner_][spender].
balanceOf uses the who parameter to index _gonBalances.
permit validates the deadline parameter against block.timestamp.
permit feeds v, r, s into ecrecover for signer authentication.
rebase computes rebaseAmount from profit_ and circulating supply.
rebase caches circulatingSupply() before mutating supply.
transfer computes gonValue = value * _gonsPerFragment.
decreaseAllowance caches oldValue before conditional subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: stakingContract_ only feeds initialize's state write and has no independent role.
_INDEX is only consumed by setIndex's INDEX write.
profit_ is only consumed by rebase's supply arithmetic.
epoch_ is only consumed by rebase's event emission.
previousCirculating_ is only consumed by _storeRebase's percent arithmetic.
to is only consumed by transfer's balance update.
value is only consumed by transfer's gon conversion.
from is only consumed by transferFrom's balance/allowance update.
spender is only consumed by approve's allowance write.
addedValue is only consumed by increaseAllowance's arithmetic.
subtractedValue is only consumed by decreaseAllowance's arithmetic.
owner_ is only consumed by allowance's lookup.
who is only consumed by balanceOf's lookup.
deadline is only consumed by permit's timestamp check.
v, r, s are only consumed by permit's ecrecover validation.
rebaseAmount is a transient local of rebase's arithmetic.
circulatingSupply_ is a transient local of rebase's arithmetic.
gonValue is a transient local of transfer's arithmetic.
oldValue is a transient local of decreaseAllowance's arithmetic.
